part2.question: A thing you did to learn another language

segments.v: I want to talk about how I learned Japanese. I started learning Japanese this year because I want to visit Japan. My friend Khoa gave me an idea. I put sticky notes on many things in my room. Each note had a Japanese word. For example, I wrote the Japanese word for “door” on my door. When I used something, I said the word. Later, I wrote short sentences on the notes. This method helped me a lot. I learned about 100 words in a few weeks. I also learned to read Japanese letters faster. My sister also learned some words. I think it is a good method because it is cheap and fun.
